svg.title: One engine step, call by call
svg.text: Engine::Step on step 3 of murmur-lab schedule: what each call changes
returns at once: this engine has no Speculator
The forward pass writes the keys and values into the pages (purple bar), but kv.length moves only
in SampleNext; there the pages that are now full are published (amber page, then green).
Plan: MakeRoom reserves pages for kv.length + count
Entries: the next count tokens; a logits row only if they reach the end
SampleNext: advance kv.length, Publish, then one sampling request per logits row
TakeTokens: Accept appends the sampled token (not cached)
